data.name: Akashy
data.gender_notes: Akashy is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘akasha’, meaning ‘space’ or ‘sky’. In Hindu mythology, Akash represents the sky and the ether, which holds all creation. This name signifies the vastness and infinite nature of the universe. The name Akashy carries the meaning “Sky, space, infinite” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Akashy usually hope their child will grow to embody sky, space, infinite and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the boundless and infinite nature of the universe.
data.etymology: Akashy belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Sky, space, infinite.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Akashy total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

data.cultural_impact: The name Akashy carries a deep cultural significance in Hinduism. In ancient Indian scriptures and mythologies, Akasha is personified as a goddess, representing the sky and the cosmic ether. The ether or space element, a fundamental element in the universe according to Hinduism, is symbolized by Akashy. Hence, the name Akashy can be seen as aconnection to the rich Hindu cultural heritage and cosmology.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, Hinduism teaches that everything in the universe is interconnected and rooted in the divine; the vastness of the cosmos is a reflection of the infinite nature of the divine. The name Akashy, being a reminder of the boundless space or sky that holds all creation, serves as a constant reminder of the divine and the interconnectedness of all things. This name imparts a sense of peace, wonder, and awe towards the creation and its eternal, infinite source.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Akashy: Dweller in the ethereal Akasha, embodiment of pure and infinite cosmic space. Akashy: One who resonates with the unmanifest Akasha, embodying the vastness and silence of the universe. Akashy: Reflection of the boundless Akasha, carrying the essence of infinite consciousness and divine presence.
